reviews.title: Easily one of my favorite idle games
reviews.text:
I rarely give 5 stars but I love this game so much. I’ve only been playing for a week but it’s amazing!! Most packages you buy are cheap and PACKED with useful things. Events aren’t shilled out every 2 weeks like most games requiring you to buy a $20 pass constantly. It’s easy and not time consuming. Log on spend your good and points, complete some easy quest and profit. You can customize your character and the weapons you use. 

Also, it’s not a game that makes you watch and AD to get offline earnings. They give you 100% of what you earned if you kept the screen on all night or day (unlike a lot of other idles) 

Overall a great game and you guys should give it a try!

Another thing is where all the upgradables are and their accessibility can feel like a maze trying to navigate. Lastly there definitely needs to be a better bag system for all your items, I feel like it would make more sense to have all obtainable like (dragon power?), cubes, large mana crystals? reviews.title: Good gameplay, mediocre creative direction
reviews.text:
For me, the appeal of RPGs isn’t just the fun of growing characters and putting together winning battle strategies, but getting immersed and invested in compelling stories, characters, and worlds with a thoughtful aesthetic. This game has plenty of the former but lacks the latter, so while it was initially enjoyable, it has nothing to keep me interested in continuing to play it. 

As mentioned, there’s nothing wrong with the gameplay, which is pretty solid idle RPG fare with plenty to upgrade, customize, and micromanage. If I was interested in gameplay alone, I would enjoy this game.

But I also want a good creative experience, and that’s where this game fails to capture my attention. The graphics are rather drab, and extremely generic. I have seen boars, wolves, orcs, and goblins in almost every other medieval fantasy game ever, and there isn’t anything new here. The game has a storylin

reviews.title: Interesting game, and pretty fun
reviews.text:
You pretty much need to atleast buy an ad removal purchase costing $7 but after that its pretty fun for atleast a week or two but then it gets too grindy.
Has some interesting mechanics but they are mostly easy to understand and sometimes some need to be tested (promotion bonuses that add to current setup, stat points, and skill combos). 
My main reason for the high rating is that the pruchases dont feel predictory and actually makes the game feel like an actual game instead of a casino and I support those kinds of games. 
Also it’s hard to contact developers but other than that solid game!

reviews.title: It’s a bit too much
reviews.text: I mean don’t get me wrong it’s a good game and you don’t really need to spend money, at least I haven’t experienced that. Honestly, my biggest problem with the game is how it throws you too much “ unnecessary “ content. It has so many different types of currency where it just gets me confused. Not to mention, sometimes the tutorial is lacking sufficient information to explain it ( if it even has one ) and what’s worse is that you CANT repeat the tutorial. I just feel that it needs to relax, quality over quantity. Maybe it’s different for other players? But it’s why I stopped playing, I was just hoping for a game I can relax without being overwhelmed by so much unnecessary dungeons. I think it has about 8-10 different types of currency ( this includes upgrade points ). So idk

reviews.title: Awesome game !
reviews.text:
As a game developer myself I can say it’s hard to balance the financial aspect and player reward system. This developer does an excellent job making the purchases good enough to feel meaningful but not so good you win the game immediately or so little that it’s not worth it. 

Gameplay itself is really good for an idol rpg, you have meaningful choices with your abilities and actions . Ex many games in the genre are a linear path with no real variation. Overall I recommend this game , the art style is really neat as well. 

5/5  - never been happier to click on a random ad.

reviews.title: Decent
reviews.text: Game is actually very fun and feels rewarding. Love the skill system, the art design, all the animations and models for characters, enemies and pets look great. The weapon combining and skill unlock system is where they lost two stars for me. Been playing my at least once a day for a couple weeks, and still can’t unlock any “Legendary” skills cause I don’t have the weapons. I spend all my gems everyday to buy weapons to combine and it doesn’t even get me close. I think skills should cost souls and your craft able weapons should uses a different resource, that way they aren’t competing with each other. Slayer and companion skills need elemental souls and weapons shouldn't be required personally.  Fix that and I’ll rate five stars.

What could I have possibly done to get suspended like this?It’s been 7 days since it started and I’ve sent countless emails but I’ve gotten no response, that’s why I’m writing this review hoping that the developers will give me a response to why I’ve been suspended & how long it will be until I can access my account again. Anyway, great game!

reviews.title: Decent idle game
reviews.text:
I’ve been playing for a month or two, almost daily — close to level 700 and cleared through stage 215.  Mechanics-wise, it’s a pretty standard idle game.

One thing I really like about the game is that it has a small purchase to remove ads, which enables you to use several privileges instantly each day.  However, basically every other purchase in the game is a HORRIBLE value.  For example: $2 gets you 1400 diamonds, and it costs 500 diamonds to pull 11 items but the draw rate for mythic items is sooo low.  At Summon Level 7, I have a 0.05% chance for a mythic, and that’s not even accounting for grade (grades 4 through 1).  Your chance to summon better weapons increases as you improve your Summon Level but it takes a long time. reviews.title: Decent game, but where’s the sound?
reviews.text:
First, I don’t think idle games can really be “fun” in the classical sense. They can be entertaining, but not really fun once you hit the wall and have to leave your phone on all night to make any real progress. 

Second, where’s the sound?? I have the sounds maxed out in the options and sound works fine on android devices, but not on my phone. I have a 2nd gen SE running the latest version of iOS as of 2023/2/19 when I downloaded this game. 

Third, I like that you’re not exactly forced to do the tutorial. You can just ignore it and carry on whatever you were doing or whatever you want to do, unlike sooo many other mobile games. That’s a nice feature.
